resources.string: Pair the phones in Android Bluetooth settings. On the other phone, open “My invitation” and choose “Receive via Bluetooth”. Then select that phone here.
Have not sent your invitation yet? Save or share it so your partner can see the same verification code.
Send this invitation as a file or exchange invitations over Bluetooth. Your calendar and private notes are not included.
This invitation includes your confirmation. Send it back to your partner to finish connecting.
